title: Chris Ballard on drafting Seth McGowan despite legal history: "I'm a second chance guy"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chris Ballard on drafting Seth McGowan despite legal history: "I'm a second chance guy"
sources.description: When Seth McGowan was a freshman running back at Oklahoma in 2020, he was arrested for stealing marijuana, jewelry and cash, pleaded guilty, served three months in jail, and was kicked off the team.
